title: What If Our Galaxy's Black Hole Woke Up? It Already Did

scenes.text: What if our galaxy's black hole woke up? Astronomers say it already has.
Sagittarius A star holds about four million times the mass of the Sun, and today it is almost silent.
About two million years ago, it erupted with roughly 100 million times the power it has now.
The blast lit up a gas cloud 200,000 light years away.
Its fingerprints, the Fermi bubbles, still cover almost a quarter of our sky.
Black holes can switch on and off within a million years. Ours is only resting.
